title: Terrarium Composer
description: Build layered glass terrariums with procedural plants, mood lighting, and a saved gallery.
concept: A generative-art diorama builder: grow five kinds of procedural plants inside a glass jar, layer sand/soil/pebble/moss substrate bands, dial in a time-of-day mood with drifting dust motes and god-rays, then save your terrarium to a gallery or export it as a PNG.
features: 5 procedural plant types (fern, succulent, cactus, mushroom cluster, vine) each drawn from a seeded RNG
layered substrate painter (sand/pebbles/soil/moss) with drag-to-build height and distinct textures per material
4-mode time-of-day lighting (dawn/day/dusk/night) with god-rays, glass tint and drifting dust motes
decoration props (rocks, crystals, mini mushrooms) scattered procedurally
one-click Grow Wild randomizer that composes a full tasteful terrarium instantly
localStorage save gallery with PNG thumbnails, click-to-reload and delete
undo last placed element and full clear/reset
autosave of the in-progress terrarium across reloads

interaction.mouse: hover tool tabs to switch modes, click inside the jar to place the selected plant/decoration, drag vertically with the layer tool to build substrate height
interaction.click: select a tool then click inside the jar to place it (or tap a light-mode button to change the mood instantly)
interaction.touch: full pointer-events support — tap to place plants/decorations, drag up inside the jar to raise a substrate layer, all buttons sized for thumb reach in a bottom action bar
interaction.keyboard: Z = undo last element, G = Grow Wild randomize, Escape closes the gallery drawer
